        "contents": "/* Copyright (c) 2018 vesoft inc. All rights reserved.\n *\n * This source code is licensed under Apache 2.0 License.\n */\n\n#ifndef WAL_WAL_H_\n#define WAL_WAL_H_\n\n#include \"common/base/Base.h\"\n#include \"common/utils/LogIterator.h\"\n\nnamespace nebula {\nnamespace wal {\n\n/**\n * Base class for all WAL implementations\n */\nclass Wal {\n public:\n  virtual ~Wal() = default;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Return the ID of the first log message in the WAL\n   */\n  virtual LogID firstLogId() const = 0;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Return the ID of the last log message in the WAL\n   */\n  virtual LogID lastLogId() const = 0;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Return the term of the last log message in the WAL\n   */\n  virtual TermID lastLogTerm() const = 0;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Return the term of specified logId, if not exist，return -1\n   */\n  virtual TermID getLogTerm(LogID id) = 0;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Append one log message to the WAL\n   *\n   * @param id Log id to append\n   * @param term Log term to append\n   * @param cluster Cluster id in log to append\n   * @param msg Log messgage to append\n   * @return  Whether append succeed\n   */\n  virtual bool appendLog(LogID id, TermID term, ClusterID cluster, std::string msg) = 0;\n\n  // Append a list of log messages to the WAL\n  /**\n   * @brief Append a list of log messages to the WAL.\n   *\n   * @param iter Log iterator to append\n   * @return  Whether append succeed\n   */\n  virtual bool appendLogs(LogIterator&amp; iter) = 0;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Rollback to the given id, all logs after the id will be discarded\n   *\n   * @param id The log id to rollback\n   * @return Whether rollback succeed\n   */\n  virtual bool rollbackToLog(LogID id) = 0;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Hard link the wal files to a new path\n   *\n   * @param newPath New wal path\n   * @return Whether link succeed\n   */\n  virtual bool linkCurrentWAL(const char* newPath) = 0;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Reset the WAL. This method is *NOT* thread safe\n   *\n   * @return Whether reset succeed\n   */\n  virtual bool reset() = 0;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Clean time expired wal by ttl\n   */",

        "contents": "/**\n * @brief An implementation of KVEngine based on Rocksdb\n *\n */\nclass RocksEngine : public KVEngine {\n  FRIEND_TEST(RocksEngineTest, SimpleTest);\n\n public:\n  /**\n   * @brief Construct a new rocksdb instance\n   *\n   * @param spaceId\n   * @param vIdLen Vertex id length, used for prefix bloom filter\n   * @param dataPath Rocksdb data path\n   * @param walPath Rocksdb wal path\n   * @param mergeOp Rocksdb merge operation\n   * @param cfFactory Rocksdb compaction filter factory\n   * @param readonly Whether start as read only instance\n   */\n  RocksEngine(GraphSpaceID spaceId,\n              int32_t vIdLen,\n              const std::string&amp; dataPath,\n              const std::string&amp; walPath = \"\",\n              std::shared_ptr&lt;rocksdb::MergeOperator&gt; mergeOp = nullptr,\n              std::shared_ptr&lt;rocksdb::CompactionFilterFactory&gt; cfFactory = nullptr,\n              bool readonly = false);\n\n  ~RocksEngine() {\n    LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Release rocksdb on \" &lt;&lt; dataPath_;\n  }\n\n  void stop() override;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Return path to a spaceId, e.g. \"/DataPath/nebula/spaceId\", usually it should contain two\n   * subdir: data and wal.\n   */\n  const char* getDataRoot() const override {\n    return dataPath_.c_str();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Return the wal path\n   */\n  const char* getWalRoot() const override {\n    return walPath_.c_str();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Get the rocksdb snapshot\n   *\n   * @return const void* Pointer of rocksdb snapshot\n   */\n  const void* GetSnapshot() override {\n    return db_-&gt;GetSnapshot();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Release the given rocksdb snapshot\n   *\n   * @param snapshot Pointer of rocksdb snapshot to release\n   */\n  void ReleaseSnapshot(const void* snapshot) override {\n    db_-&gt;ReleaseSnapshot(reinterpret_cast&lt;const rocksdb::Snapshot*&gt;(snapshot));\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief return a WriteBatch object to do batch operation\n   *\n   * @return std::unique_ptr&lt;WriteBatch&gt;\n   */\n  std::unique_ptr&lt;WriteBatch&gt; startBatchWrite() override;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief write the batch operation into kv engine\n   *\n   * @param batch WriteBatch object\n   * @param disableWAL Whether wal is disabled, only used in rocksdb\n   * @param sync Whether need to sync when write, only used in rocksdb\n   * @param wait Whether wait until write result, rocksdb would return incompelete if wait is false\n   * in certain scenario\n   * @return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode\n   */",

        "contents": "  friend class ListenerBasicTest;\n\n public:\n  /**\n   * @brief Construct a new NebulaStore object\n   *\n   * @param options\n   * @param ioPool IOThreadPool\n   * @param serviceAddr Address of NebulaStore, used in raft\n   * @param workers Worker thread\n   */\n  NebulaStore(KVOptions options,\n              std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::IOThreadPoolExecutor&gt; ioPool,\n              HostAddr serviceAddr,\n              std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::Executor&gt; workers)\n      : ioPool_(ioPool),\n        storeSvcAddr_(serviceAddr),\n        workers_(workers),\n        raftAddr_(getRaftAddr(serviceAddr)),\n        options_(std::move(options)) {\n    CHECK_NOTNULL(options_.partMan_);\n    clientMan_ =\n        std::make_shared&lt;thrift::ThriftClientManager&lt;raftex::cpp2::RaftexServiceAsyncClient&gt;&gt;(\n            FLAGS_enable_ssl);\n  }\n\n  ~NebulaStore();\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Calculate the raft service address based on the storage service address\n   *\n   * @param srvcAddr Storage service address\n   * @return HostAddr Raft service address\n   */\n  static HostAddr getRaftAddr(const HostAddr&amp; srvcAddr) {\n    return Utils::getRaftAddrFromStoreAddr(srvcAddr);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Calculate the storage service address based on the raft service address\n   *\n   * @param raftAddr Raft service address\n   * @return HostAddr Storage service address\n   */\n  static HostAddr getStoreAddr(const HostAddr&amp; raftAddr) {\n    return Utils::getStoreAddrFromRaftAddr(raftAddr);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Pull meta information from the PartManager and initiate the current store instance\n   *\n   * @return True if succeed. False if failed.\n   */\n  bool init();\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Stop the engine\n   */\n  void stop() override;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Return bit-wise capability, not used\n   */\n  uint32_t capability() const override {\n    return 0;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Return storage service address\n   */\n  HostAddr address() const {\n    return storeSvcAddr_;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Get the IOThreadPool\n   */\n  std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::IOThreadPoolExecutor&gt; getIoPool() const {\n    return ioPool_;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Get the Background workers\n   */",

        "contents": "/* Copyright (c) 2020 vesoft inc. All rights reserved.\n *\n * This source code is licensed under Apache 2.0 License.\n */\n\n#ifndef KVSTORE_LISTENER_LISTENER_H_\n#define KVSTORE_LISTENER_LISTENER_H_\n\n#include \"common/base/Base.h\"\n#include \"common/meta/SchemaManager.h\"\n#include \"kvstore/Common.h\"\n#include \"kvstore/LogEncoder.h\"\n#include \"kvstore/raftex/Host.h\"\n#include \"kvstore/raftex/RaftPart.h\"\n#include \"kvstore/wal/FileBasedWal.h\"\n\nDECLARE_int32(cluster_id);\n\nnamespace nebula {\nnamespace kvstore {\n\nusing RaftClient = thrift::ThriftClientManager&lt;raftex::cpp2::RaftexServiceAsyncClient&gt;;\n\n/**\n * Listener is a special RaftPart, it will join the raft group as learner. The key difference\n * between learner (e.g. in balance data) and listener is that, listener won't be able to be\n * promoted to follower or leader.\n *\n * Once it joins raft group, it can receive logs from leader and do whatever you like. When listener\n * receives logs from leader, it will just write wal and update committedLogId_, none of the logs is\n * applied to state machine, which is different from follower/learner. There will be another thread\n * trigger the apply within a certain interval (listener_commit_interval_secs), it will get the logs\n * in range of [lastApplyLogId_ + 1, committedLogId_], and decode these logs into kv, and apply them\n * to state machine.\n *\n * If you want to add a new type of listener, just inherit from Listener. There are some interface\n * you need to implement, some of them has been implemented in Listener. Others need to implemented\n * in derived class.\n *\n * * Implemented in Listener, could override if necessary\n *   // Start listener as learner\n *   void start(std::vector&lt;HostAddr&gt;&amp;&amp; peers, bool asLearner)\n *\n *   // Stop the listener\n *   void stop()\n *\n *   void onLostLeadership(TermID term)\n *\n *   void onElected(TermID term)\n *\n *   void onDiscoverNewLeader(HostAddr nLeader)\n *\n *   // For listener, we just return true directly. Another background thread trigger the actual\n *   // apply work, and do it in worker thread, and update lastApplyLogId_\n *   std::tuple&lt;nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode, LogID, TermID&gt;\n *   commitLogs(std::unique_ptr&lt;LogIterator&gt; iter, bool)\n *\n *   // For most of the listeners, just return true is enough. However, if listener need to be\n *   // aware of membership change, some log type of wal need to be pre-processed, could do it\n *   // here.\n *   bool preProcessLog(LogID logId, TermID termId, ClusterID clusterId, const std::string&amp; log)\n *\n *   // If listener falls far behind from leader, leader would send snapshot to listener. The\n *   // snapshot is a vector of kv, listener could decode them and treat them as normal logs until\n *   // all snapshot has been received.\n *   std::tuple&lt;cpp2::ErrorCode, int64_t, int64_t&gt; commitSnapshot(\n *        const std::vector&lt;std::string&gt;&amp; data,\n *        LogID committedLogId,\n *        TermID committedLogTerm,\n *        bool finished) override;\n *\n *   // extra cleanup work, will be invoked when listener is about to be removed,\n *   // or raft is reset\n *   void cleanup()；\n *\n * * Must implement in derived class\n *   // extra initialize work could do here\n *   void init()\n *\n *   // Main interface to process logs, listener need to apply the committed log entry to their\n *   // state machine. Once apply succeeded, user should call persist() to make their progress\n *   // persisted.\n *   virtual void processLogs() = 0;\n *\n *   // read last commit log id and term from external storage, used in initialization\n *   std::pair&lt;LogID, TermID&gt; lastCommittedLogId()\n *\n *   // read last apply id from external storage, used in initialization\n *   LogID lastApplyLogId()\n *\n *   // persist last commit log id/term and lastApplyId\n *   bool persist(LogID, TermID, LogID)\n */\nclass Listener : public raftex::RaftPart {\n public:\n  /**\n   * @brief Construct a new Listener, it is a derived class of RaftPart\n   *\n   * @param spaceId\n   * @param partId\n   * @param localAddr Listener ip/addr\n   * @param walPath Listener's wal path\n   * @param ioPool IOThreadPool for listener\n   * @param workers Background thread for listener\n   * @param handlers Worker thread for listener\n   */",
        "signatures": {},

## NebulaStore 类概述

**NebulaStore** 是 Nebula Graph 存储层的核心实现类，继承自 `KVStore`（抽象接口）和 `Handler`。

### 主要职责

1. 分布式 KV 存储管理
   - 管理多个图空间（Space）和分区（Partition）
   - 每个 Space 包含多个 Partition，每个 Partition 对应一个 `Part` 对象

2. 数据操作接口
   - 单键读写：`get()`, `asyncMultiPut()`
   - 批量操作：`multiGet()`, `asyncMultiRemove()`
   - 范围查询：`range()`, `prefix()`, `rangeWithPrefix()`
   - 原子操作：`asyncAtomicOp()`

3. Raft 一致性
   - 基于 Raft 实现多副本复制
   - 管理 Leader/Follower 角色
   - 提供 `partLeader()` 查询当前 Leader

4. 底层存储引擎
   - 使用 `KVEngine`（如 RocksDB）作为底层存储
   - 管理多个存储引擎实例（每个 Space 可能有多个引擎）

5. 高级功能
   - Listener：支持监听器模式（如 Elasticsearch Listener）
   - 快照：`GetSnapshot()`, `createCheckpoint()`
   - 备份恢复：`backup()`, `restoreFromFiles()`
   - 数据迁移：支持分区迁移和恢复

### 核心数据结构

```cpp
// 每个 Space 包含多个 Partition 和存储引擎
std::unordered_map<GraphSpaceID, std::shared_ptr<SpacePartInfo>> spaces_;

// Listener 信息
std::unordered_map<GraphSpaceID, std::shared_ptr<SpaceListenerInfo>> spaceListeners_;
```

### 关键组件

- `PartManager`：分区管理器，管理分区元数据
- `RaftexService`：Raft 服务，处理 Raft 协议通信
- `SnapshotManager`：快照管理器
- `DiskManager`：磁盘空间管理
- `KVEngine`：底层存储引擎（如 RocksDB）

**总结**：`NebulaStore` 是 Nebula Graph 存储服务的核心实现，负责分布式 KV 存储、Raft 一致性、分区管理和数据操作。

        "contents": "DECLARE_int32(wal_ttl);\n\nnamespace nebula {\nnamespace kvstore {\n\nNebulaStore::~NebulaStore() {\n  stop();\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Cut off the relationship with meta client\";\n  options_.partMan_.reset();\n  bgWorkers_-&gt;stop();\n  bgWorkers_-&gt;wait();\n  storeWorker_-&gt;stop();\n  storeWorker_-&gt;wait();\n  spaces_.clear();\n  spaceListeners_.clear();\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"~NebulaStore()\";\n}\n\nbool NebulaStore::init() {\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Start the raft service...\";\n  bgWorkers_ = std::make_shared&lt;thread::GenericThreadPool&gt;();\n  bgWorkers_-&gt;start(FLAGS_num_workers, \"nebula-bgworkers\");\n  storeWorker_ = std::make_shared&lt;thread::GenericWorker&gt;();\n  CHECK(storeWorker_-&gt;start());\n  snapshot_.reset(new NebulaSnapshotManager(this));\n  raftService_ = raftex::RaftexService::createService(ioPool_, workers_, raftAddr_.port);\n  if (raftService_ == nullptr) {\n    LOG(ERROR) &lt;&lt; \"Start the raft service failed\";\n    return false;\n  }\n  diskMan_.reset(new DiskManager(options_.dataPaths_, storeWorker_));\n  // todo(doodle): we could support listener and normal storage start at same\n  // instance\n  if (!isListener()) {\n    // TODO(spw): need to refactor, we could load data from local regardless of partManager,\n    // then adjust the data in loadPartFromPartManager.\n    loadPartFromDataPath();\n    loadPartFromPartManager();\n    loadRemoteListenerFromPartManager();\n  } else {\n    loadLocalListenerFromPartManager();\n  }\n\n  storeWorker_-&gt;addDelayTask(FLAGS_clean_wal_interval_secs * 1000, &amp;NebulaStore::cleanWAL, this);\n  storeWorker_-&gt;addRepeatTask(\n      FLAGS_rocksdb_backup_interval_secs * 1000, &amp;NebulaStore::backup, this);\n  LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Register handler...\";\n  options_.partMan_-&gt;registerHandler(this);\n  return true;\n}\n\nvoid NebulaStore::loadPartFromDataPath()",

        "contents": "  // PartManager instance for kvstore.\n  std::unique_ptr&lt;PartManager&gt; partMan_{nullptr};\n\n  // Custom MergeOperator used in rocksdb.merge method.\n  std::shared_ptr&lt;rocksdb::MergeOperator&gt; mergeOp_{nullptr};\n\n  // Custom CompactionFilter used in compaction.\n  std::unique_ptr&lt;CompactionFilterFactoryBuilder&gt; cffBuilder_{nullptr};\n};\n\nstruct StoreCapability {\n  static const uint32_t SC_FILTERING = 1;\n  static const uint32_t SC_ASYNC = 2;\n};\n#define SUPPORT_FILTERING(store) (store.capability() &amp; StoreCapability::SC_FILTERING)\n\nclass Part;\n/**\n * @brief Interfaces of kvstore\n */\nclass KVStore {\n public:\n  virtual ~KVStore() = default;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Return bit-OR of StoreCapability values;\n   *\n   * @return uint32_t Bitwise capability\n   */\n  virtual uint32_t capability() const = 0;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Stop the kvstore\n   */\n  virtual void stop() = 0;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Retrieve the current leader for the given partition. This is usually called when\n   * E_LEADER_CHANGED error code is returned.\n   *\n   * @param spaceId\n   * @param partID\n   * @return ErrorOr&lt;nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode, HostAddr&gt; Return HostAddr when succeeded, return\n   * ErrorCode when failed\n   */\n  virtual ErrorOr&lt;nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode, HostAddr&gt; partLeader(GraphSpaceID spaceId,\n                                                                PartitionID partID) = 0;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Return pointer of part manager\n   *\n   * @return PartManager*\n   */\n  virtual PartManager* partManager() const {\n    return nullptr;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Get the Snapshot object\n   *\n   * @param spaceId Space id\n   * @param partID Partition id\n   * @param canReadFromFollower\n   * @return const void* Snapshot.\n   */\n  virtual const void* GetSnapshot(GraphSpaceID spaceId, PartitionID partID) = 0;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Release snapshot.\n   *\n   * @param spaceId Space id.\n   * @param partId Partition id.\n   * @param snapshot Snapshot to release.\n   */\n  virtual void ReleaseSnapshot(GraphSpaceID spaceId, PartitionID partId, const void* snapshot) = 0;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Read a single key\n   *\n   * @param spaceId\n   * @param partId\n   * @param key\n   * @param value\n   * @param canReadFromFollower\n   * @return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode\n   */",

        "contents": "/* Copyright (c) 2020 vesoft inc. All rights reserved.\n *\n * This source code is licensed under Apache 2.0 License.\n */\n\n#ifndef KVSTORE_LISTENER_LISTENER_H_\n#define KVSTORE_LISTENER_LISTENER_H_\n\n#include \"common/base/Base.h\"\n#include \"common/meta/SchemaManager.h\"\n#include \"kvstore/Common.h\"\n#include \"kvstore/LogEncoder.h\"\n#include \"kvstore/raftex/Host.h\"\n#include \"kvstore/raftex/RaftPart.h\"\n#include \"kvstore/wal/FileBasedWal.h\"\n\nDECLARE_int32(cluster_id);\n\nnamespace nebula {\nnamespace kvstore {\n\nusing RaftClient = thrift::ThriftClientManager&lt;raftex::cpp2::RaftexServiceAsyncClient&gt;;\n\n/**\n * Listener is a special RaftPart, it will join the raft group as learner. The key difference\n * between learner (e.g. in balance data) and listener is that, listener won't be able to be\n * promoted to follower or leader.\n *\n * Once it joins raft group, it can receive logs from leader and do whatever you like. When listener\n * receives logs from leader, it will just write wal and update committedLogId_, none of the logs is\n * applied to state machine, which is different from follower/learner. There will be another thread\n * trigger the apply within a certain interval (listener_commit_interval_secs), it will get the logs\n * in range of [lastApplyLogId_ + 1, committedLogId_], and decode these logs into kv, and apply them\n * to state machine.\n *\n * If you want to add a new type of listener, just inherit from Listener. There are some interface\n * you need to implement, some of them has been implemented in Listener. Others need to implemented\n * in derived class.\n *\n * * Implemented in Listener, could override if necessary\n *   // Start listener as learner\n *   void start(std::vector&lt;HostAddr&gt;&amp;&amp; peers, bool asLearner)\n *\n *   // Stop the listener\n *   void stop()\n *\n *   void onLostLeadership(TermID term)\n *\n *   void onElected(TermID term)\n *\n *   void onDiscoverNewLeader(HostAddr nLeader)\n *\n *   // For listener, we just return true directly. Another background thread trigger the actual\n *   // apply work, and do it in worker thread, and update lastApplyLogId_\n *   std::tuple&lt;nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode, LogID, TermID&gt;\n *   commitLogs(std::unique_ptr&lt;LogIterator&gt; iter, bool)\n *\n *   // For most of the listeners, just return true is enough. However, if listener need to be\n *   // aware of membership change, some log type of wal need to be pre-processed, could do it\n *   // here.\n *   bool preProcessLog(LogID logId, TermID termId, ClusterID clusterId, const std::string&amp; log)\n *\n *   // If listener falls far behind from leader, leader would send snapshot to listener. The\n *   // snapshot is a vector of kv, listener could decode them and treat them as normal logs until\n *   // all snapshot has been received.\n *   std::tuple&lt;cpp2::ErrorCode, int64_t, int64_t&gt; commitSnapshot(\n *        const std::vector&lt;std::string&gt;&amp; data,\n *        LogID committedLogId,\n *        TermID committedLogTerm,\n *        bool finished) override;\n *\n *   // extra cleanup work, will be invoked when listener is about to be removed,\n *   // or raft is reset\n *   void cleanup()；\n *\n * * Must implement in derived class\n *   // extra initialize work could do here\n *   void init()\n *\n *   // Main interface to process logs, listener need to apply the committed log entry to their\n *   // state machine. Once apply succeeded, user should call persist() to make their progress\n *   // persisted.\n *   virtual void processLogs() = 0;\n *\n *   // read last commit log id and term from external storage, used in initialization\n *   std::pair&lt;LogID, TermID&gt; lastCommittedLogId()\n *\n *   // read last apply id from external storage, used in initialization\n *   LogID lastApplyLogId()\n *\n *   // persist last commit log id/term and lastApplyId\n *   bool persist(LogID, TermID, LogID)\n */\nclass Listener : public raftex::RaftPart {\n public:\n  /**\n   * @brief Construct a new Listener, it is a derived class of RaftPart\n   *\n   * @param spaceId\n   * @param partId\n   * @param localAddr Listener ip/addr\n   * @param walPath Listener's wal path\n   * @param ioPool IOThreadPool for listener\n   * @param workers Background thread for listener\n   * @param handlers Worker thread for listener\n   */",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "  friend class ListenerBasicTest;\n\n public:\n  /**\n   * @brief Construct a new NebulaStore object\n   *\n   * @param options\n   * @param ioPool IOThreadPool\n   * @param serviceAddr Address of NebulaStore, used in raft\n   * @param workers Worker thread\n   */\n  NebulaStore(KVOptions options,\n              std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::IOThreadPoolExecutor&gt; ioPool,\n              HostAddr serviceAddr,\n              std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::Executor&gt; workers)\n      : ioPool_(ioPool),\n        storeSvcAddr_(serviceAddr),\n        workers_(workers),\n        raftAddr_(getRaftAddr(serviceAddr)),\n        options_(std::move(options)) {\n    CHECK_NOTNULL(options_.partMan_);\n    clientMan_ =\n        std::make_shared&lt;thrift::ThriftClientManager&lt;raftex::cpp2::RaftexServiceAsyncClient&gt;&gt;(\n            FLAGS_enable_ssl);\n  }\n\n  ~NebulaStore();\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Calculate the raft service address based on the storage service address\n   *\n   * @param srvcAddr Storage service address\n   * @return HostAddr Raft service address\n   */\n  static HostAddr getRaftAddr(const HostAddr&amp; srvcAddr) {\n    return Utils::getRaftAddrFromStoreAddr(srvcAddr);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Calculate the storage service address based on the raft service address\n   *\n   * @param raftAddr Raft service address\n   * @return HostAddr Storage service address\n   */\n  static HostAddr getStoreAddr(const HostAddr&amp; raftAddr) {\n    return Utils::getStoreAddrFromRaftAddr(raftAddr);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Pull meta information from the PartManager and initiate the current store instance\n   *\n   * @return True if succeed. False if failed.\n   */\n  bool init();\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Stop the engine\n   */\n  void stop() override;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Return bit-wise capability, not used\n   */\n  uint32_t capability() const override {\n    return 0;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Return storage service address\n   */\n  HostAddr address() const {\n    return storeSvcAddr_;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Get the IOThreadPool\n   */\n  std::shared_ptr&lt;folly::IOThreadPoolExecutor&gt; getIoPool() const {\n    return ioPool_;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Get the Background workers\n   */",

        "contents": "/* Copyright (c) 2018 vesoft inc. All rights reserved.\n *\n * This source code is licensed under Apache 2.0 License.\n */\n\n#ifndef KVSTORE_KVENGINE_H_\n#define KVSTORE_KVENGINE_H_\n\n#include \"common/base/Base.h\"\n#include \"common/base/ErrorOr.h\"\n#include \"common/base/Status.h\"\n#include \"kvstore/Common.h\"\n#include \"kvstore/KVIterator.h\"\n\nnamespace nebula {\nnamespace kvstore {\n\n/**\n * @brief wrapper of batch write\n */\nclass WriteBatch {\n public:\n  virtual ~WriteBatch() = default;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Encode the operation of put key/value into write batch\n   *\n   * @param key Key to put\n   * @param value Value to put\n   * @return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode\n   */\n  virtual nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode put(folly::StringPiece key, folly::StringPiece value) = 0;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Encode the operation of remove key into write batch\n   *\n   * @param key Key to remove\n   * @return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode\n   */\n  virtual nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode remove(folly::StringPiece key) = 0;\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Encode the operation of remove keys in range [start, end) into write batch\n   *\n   * @param start Start key to be removed, inclusive\n   * @param end End key to be removed, exclusive\n   * @return nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode\n   */\n  virtual nebula::cpp2::ErrorCode removeRange(folly::StringPiece start, folly::StringPiece end) = 0;\n};\n\n/**\n * @brief Key-value engine object\n */\nclass KVEngine {\n public:\n  explicit KVEngine(GraphSpaceID spaceId) :",

        "contents": "/* Copyright (c) 2021 vesoft inc. All rights reserved.\n *\n * This source code is licensed under Apache 2.0 License.\n */\n\n#ifndef KVSTORE_RATELIMITER_H\n#define KVSTORE_RATELIMITER_H\n\n#include &lt;folly/TokenBucket.h&gt;\n\n#include \"common/base/Base.h\"\n#include \"common/thrift/ThriftTypes.h\"\n#include \"common/time/WallClock.h\"\n\nDECLARE_bool(skip_wait_in_rate_limiter);\n\nnamespace nebula {\nnamespace kvstore {\n\n// A simple wrapper for folly::TokenBucket, it would limit the speed to rate_ * buckets_.size().\n// For now, there are two major cases: snapshot (both for balance or catch up) and rebuild index.\nclass RateLimiter {\n public:\n  RateLimiter() {\n    // token will be available after 1 second, to prevent speed spike at the beginning\n    auto now = time::WallClock::fastNowInSec();\n    int64_t waitInSec = FLAGS_skip_wait_in_rate_limiter ? 0 : 1;\n    bucket_.reset(new folly::DynamicTokenBucket(static_cast&lt;double&gt;(now + waitInSec)));\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * @brief Consume some budget from rate limiter. Caller must make sure the **the partition has\n   * been add, and won't be removed during consume.** Snapshot and rebuild index follow this\n   * principle by design.\n   *\n   * @param toConsume Amount to consume\n   * @param rate Generate speed\n   * @param burstSize Maximum consume speed to consume\n   */\n  void consume(double toConsume, double rate, double burstSize) {\n    if (toConsume &gt; burstSize) {\n      // consumeWithBorrowAndWait do nothing when toConsume &gt; burstSize_, we sleep 1s instead\n      std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(1));\n    } else {\n      // If there are enough tokens, consume and return immediately.\n      // If not, consume anyway, but sleep enough time before return.\n      auto now = time::WallClock::fastNowInSec();\n      bucket_-&gt;consumeWithBorrowAndWait(toConsume, rate, burstSize, static_cast&lt;double&gt;(now));\n    }\n  }\n\n private:\n  std::unique_ptr&lt;folly::DynamicTokenBucket&gt; bucket_;\n};\n\n}  // namespace kvstore\n}  // namespace nebula\n#endif",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

          {
            "text": " public:",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "  RateLimiter() {",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "    // token will be available after 1 second, to prevent speed spike at the beginning",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "    auto now = time::WallClock::fastNowInSec();",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "    int64_t waitInSec = FLAGS_skip_wait_in_rate_limiter ? 0 : 1;",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    bucket_.reset(new folly::DynamicTokenBucket(static_cast&lt;double&gt;(now + waitInSec)));",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "  }",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "  /**",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "   * @brief Consume some budget from rate limiter. Caller must make sure the **the partition has",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "   * been add, and won't be removed during consume.** Snapshot and rebuild index follow this",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "   * principle by design.",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "   *",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "   * @param toConsume Amount to consume",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "   * @param rate Generate speed",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "   * @param burstSize Maximum consume speed to consume",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "   */",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "  void consume(double toConsume, double rate, double burstSize) {",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (toConsume &gt; burstSize) {",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "      // consumeWithBorrowAndWait do nothing when toConsume &gt; burstSize_, we sleep 1s instead",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "      std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(1));",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "    } else {",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "      // If there are enough tokens, consume and return immediately.",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "      // If not, consume anyway, but sleep enough time before return.",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "      auto now = time::WallClock::fastNowInSec();",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "      bucket_-&gt;consumeWithBorrowAndWait(toConsume, rate, burstSize, static_cast&lt;double&gt;(now));",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "  }",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": " private:",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "  std::unique_ptr&lt;folly::DynamicTokenBucket&gt; bucket_;",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "};",

        "contents": "struct Peer {\n  // Mainly used in balancing to keep the status which is not reflected in the meta service.\n  // Then when restarting, we could restore the balancing progress.\n  enum class Status : uint8_t {\n    kNormalPeer = 0,    // normal raft peer, kept in the meta part info\n    kLearner = 1,       // learner peer for catching up data, and not kept in the meta\n    kPromotedPeer = 2,  // promoted from learner to normal peer, but not kept in the meta\n    kDeleted = 3,       // indicate this peer should be removed, will not exist in the persist data\n    kMax = 4,           // a special value, used as a delimiter when deserializing.\n  };\n\n  HostAddr addr;\n  Status status;\n\n  Peer() : addr(), status(Status::kNormalPeer) {}\n  explicit Peer(HostAddr a) : addr(a), status(Status::kNormalPeer) {}\n  Peer(HostAddr a, Status s) : addr(a), status(s) {}\n\n  std::string toString() const {\n    return addr.toString() + \",\" + std::to_string(static_cast&lt;int&gt;(status));\n  }\n\n  void fromString(const std::string&amp; str) {\n    auto pos = str.find(\",\");\n    if (pos == std::string::npos) {\n      LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Parse peer failed:\" &lt;&lt; str;\n      return;\n    }\n    addr = HostAddr::fromString(str.substr(0, pos));\n\n    int s = std::stoi(str.substr(pos + 1));\n    if (s &gt;= static_cast&lt;int&gt;(Status::kMax) || s &lt; 0) {\n      LOG(INFO) &lt;&lt; \"Parse peer status failed:\" &lt;&lt; str;\n      return;\n    }\n\n    status = static_cast&lt;Status&gt;(s);\n  }\n\n  bool operator==(const Peer&amp; rhs) const {\n    return addr == rhs.addr &amp;&amp; status == rhs.status;\n  }\n\n  bool operator!=(const Peer&amp; rhs) const {\n    return !(*this == rhs);\n  }\n\n  static Peer nullPeer() {\n    return Peer();\n  }\n};\n\ninline std::ostream&amp; operator&lt;&lt;(std::ostream&amp; os, const Peer&amp; peer) {\n  return os &lt;&lt; peer.toString();\n}\n\n/**\n * @brief Peers for one partition, it should handle serializing and deserializing.\n *\n */\nstruct Peers {\n private:\n  std::map&lt;HostAddr, Peer&gt; peers;\n  int64_t createdTime;",

## 关系

**NebulaStore** 同时继承自 **KVStore** 和 **Handler**：

1. **KVStore**（接口）
   - 定义数据操作接口：`get()`, `put()`, `range()`, `prefix()` 等
   - NebulaStore 实现这些接口，提供实际的数据读写能力

2. **Handler**（回调接口）
   - 定义分区管理回调：`addSpace()`, `addPart()`, `removeSpace()`, `removePart()` 等
   - NebulaStore 实现这些接口，响应 PartManager 的分区变化通知

**总结**：NebulaStore = KVStore（数据操作） + Handler（分区管理回调），是存储层的具体实现。

## 为什么这里多重继承是合理的

这里使用多重继承是合理的，原因：

1. 两个基类都是纯接口类
   - `KVStore`：纯虚函数接口，无数据成员
   - `Handler`：纯虚函数接口，无数据成员

2. 没有菱形继承问题
   - 两个基类互不继承，不会出现重复继承

3. 这是接口继承，不是实现继承
   - 类似 Java 的 `implements`，C++ 中通过多重继承实现多个接口是常见做法

4. 职责分离清晰
   - `KVStore`：数据操作接口
   - `Handler`：分区管理回调接口
   - 两者职责不同，组合在一起更自然

**结论**：多重继承要避免的是有状态的基类继承（可能导致数据成员重复、初始化顺序问题等）。对于纯接口类，多重继承是常见且安全的做法。

---

_**User**_

有状态的基类继承（可能导致数据成员重复、初始化顺序问题等）说的都是棱形继承吧？简洁回答

---

_**Agent (model composer-1, mode Agent)**_


主要是菱形继承，但非菱形继承也可能有初始化顺序问题。

**菱形继承**：
```
    A (有数据成员)
   / \
  B   C
   \ /
    D
```
- 数据成员重复（D 中有两份 A 的数据）
- 初始化顺序复杂

**非菱形多重继承**（如 NebulaStore）：
```
KVStore  Handler
    \     /
   NebulaStore
```
- 如果两个基类都有状态，构造函数初始化顺序需要明确
- 但这里两个基类都是纯接口（无状态），所以没问题

**结论**：菱形继承是主要问题，但多重继承有状态基类时，即使非菱形也要注意初始化顺序。纯接口类多重继承是安全的。

---

_**User**_

不是谁写在前先初始化谁？

---

_**Agent (model composer-1, mode Agent)**_


是的，按继承列表中的声明顺序初始化，而不是按初始化列表的顺序。

```cpp
class NebulaStore : public KVStore, public Handler {
  NebulaStore() : Handler(), KVStore() {}  // 初始化列表顺序不重要
};
```

实际初始化顺序：先 `KVStore`，后 `Handler`（按继承列表顺序）。

**规则**：基类初始化顺序 = 继承列表声明顺序，与初始化列表顺序无关。

因此，即使两个基类都有状态，只要按继承顺序初始化即可，不会有问题。菱形继承的问题在于同一基类被多次继承，导致数据重复。

---

_**User**_

那注意这个干嘛？不都规定好了？

---

_**Agent (model composer-1, mode Agent)**_

顺序是固定的，但要注意：

**问题场景**：如果基类之间有依赖关系

```cpp
class KVStore {
  KVStore() { 
    // 假设这里需要用到 Handler 的某些状态
    // 但 Handler 还没初始化！
  }
};

class Handler {
  int state_;
};
```

如果 `KVStore` 的构造函数依赖 `Handler` 的状态，但按继承顺序 `KVStore` 先初始化，就会出问题。

**结论**：
- 顺序是固定的，不需要手动控制
- 但设计时基类之间不应有依赖关系
- 纯接口类（无状态、无构造函数逻辑）最安全，不会有这个问题

所以“注意”指的是：设计时避免基类间依赖，而不是手动控制顺序。
